title: Collect a YouTube reference
description: Retain the selected video with audio and five sampled frames in this project. Requires the optional YoutubeExplode engine. This collects a reference; it does not generate or publish a video. Up to one hour and 256 MiB.
author: Viral Hit

parameters.label: YouTube video ID
parameters.description: The 11-character ID from the video link. Public videos only; no account cookies are used.

parameters.label: Maximum height
parameters.description: Select the highest available MP4 rendition within this height. Lower heights use less bandwidth.
